name: River Song
oracle_text:
Meet in Reverse — You draw cards from the bottom of your library rather than the top.
Spoilers — Whenever an opponent scries, surveils, or searches their library, put a +1/+1 counter on River Song. Then River Song deals damage to that player equal to its power.
blocked_sentences: Meet in Reverse — You draw cards from the bottom of your library rather than the top.
Spoilers — Whenever an opponent scries, surveils, or searches their library, put a +1/+1 counter on River Song. Then River Song deals damage to that player equal to its power.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "you") under which every card the affected player draws is taken from the bottom of their library instead of the top
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_draw only multiplies the number of cards drawn (draw_multiplier, except_first_in_draw_step); the packet notes say a draw replacement doing anything other than drawing more is still a gap, and no other static touches which library position a draw takes from

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a player scries (with the scrying player bindable as the damaged player), so one trigger can cover 'whenever an opponent scries, surveils, or searches their library'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has surveils and searches_library but no scry event, so the scry third of the printed trigger cannot be written; writing only the other two events would drop a clause
